template_text: The Receiving Party shall keep confidential and shall not disclose to any third party any Confidential Information received from the Disclosing Party.
Confidentiality obligations shall survive for a defined period after disclosure, except for trade secrets which remain protected while they qualify as trade secrets.
description: Limits how long confidentiality duties last.

template_text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
description: Specifies which jurisdiction laws govern the contract.

template_text: The Buyer shall pay invoices within the agreed number of days of receipt, and overdue amounts may accrue interest as permitted by law.
description: Defines payment deadlines and remedies for late payment.

template_text: The Employee's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be limited, except in cases of fraud or wilful misconduct.
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing written notice or payment in lieu of notice on a reciprocal basis.
description: Protects against abrupt termination without compensation.

template_text: The Provider shall meet the service levels, uptime commitments, and remedies described in this Agreement.
Fees are payable according to the schedule in this Agreement, and invoices shall specify due dates.
The Landlord shall hold any security deposit in accordance with applicable law and return it within the statutory period after deduction of documented dues.
Either party shall provide written notice before termination or non-renewal of the lease in accordance with applicable rent laws.
description: Requires advance notice before ending occupancy.
